glossary.definition: (1) "Employee" and "employer" have the same meanings as in section 4113.51 of the Revised Code except that "employer" does not include the state, any municipal corporation, county, township, school district, or other political subdivision, or any agency or instrumentality of any of those entities.
glossary.source_title: Section 4113.75 - Automatic contributions to employee retirement plan.

glossary.definition: (2) "Employee retirement plan" means an employee retirement plan described in section 401(k) or 403(b) of the Internal Revenue Code or a payroll deduction individual retirement account plan described in section 408 or 408A of the Internal Revenue Code.
glossary.source_title: Section 4113.75 - Automatic contributions to employee retirement plan.
